SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers My class, part of MY SCHOOL Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Learning Experi in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: how to care for the various items found in class. 1. Which items do we find in our class? 2. How do we keep items in the classroom?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
